```yaml
name: Test vfox

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - crates/vfox/**
      - .github/workflows/test-vfox.yml
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - crates/vfox/**
      - .github/workflows/test-vfox.yml

jobs:
  test:
    name: Test vfox on ${{ matrix.os }} (${{ matrix.rust }}) with ${{ matrix.features }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest, macos-latest]
        rust: [stable, beta, nightly]
        features: ["", "--all-features", "--no-default-features"]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: ${{ matrix.rust }}
          components: rustfmt, clippy
          cache: true

      - name: Run tests
        uses: actions-rs/cargo@v1
        with:
          command: test
          args: -p vfox ${{ matrix.features }}
          toolchain: ${{ matrix.rust }}
          use-cross: false
```
